definitions: An essential or integral part of something.
A fundamental and unavoidable aspect of a situation or experience.
examples: Long hours are part and parcel of being a doctor.
Dealing with criticism is part and parcel of public life.
The challenges are part and parcel of any new project.
lemma: be part and parcel of something
synonyms: be an integral part of something
be an essential component of something
source: be part and parcel of something
